cases.name: test_cli_ready_source_inode_replacement_refuses_go_and_keeps_reservation
cases.route: Real first commandDomain CLI publishes a confirmed source artifact. Second actual CLI selects json_observations. Transparent actual prepare_supervised returns a real READY handle, retained before fault; only then replace the source path with identical bytes at a new inode.
cases.asserted: CLI75; actual inode changed with byte equality and original preserved; no worker GO marker; captured supervisor confirms STOP closure; analysis is LAUNCHING/RUNNING without terminal, artifact or observation rows; its reservation remains BOUND while source reservation remains SETTLED.

cases.name: test_cli_terminal_trigger_changes_real_input_after_analysis_registration_and_rolls_back
cases.route: Real first CLI commandDomain source, then real json_observations worker. Transparent register_artifacts calls the actual writer before installing a same-writer terminal AFTER trigger. The trigger calls a test SQL observer with real analysis artifact, real analysis observation and original input records, then changes the input content_sha256.
cases.asserted: Observer reached exactly once and proves both output registrations already existed, correct full producer/evaluator/input/result IDs; actual worker return0 with no STOP; CLI75; whole SQL terminal/publication rolls back, old input metadata remains byte-equivalent, reservation remains BOUND; prepared filesystem effect remains without committed confirmation.
cases.fault_boundary: Explicit mutation through SQLite trigger in the real terminal writer, not a claim that a concurrent writer crosses BEGIN IMMEDIATE, and not fabricated artifact/observation rows.
